Reviewed fixed-frame error, native-exclusion gaps, support coverage, ordering stability, and local resource measurements in the executed report.

items.title: Run fixed-cohort local-data budget replay (protocol v2)
items.notes: Protocol v2 executed: cutoff 100, entire eligible cohort of 16,084 users, 4,100 evaluated, stratified reporting and self-normalized propensity weighting. The deterministic item-item probe measures a significant deficit in all 12 cap/policy cells, from -0.0058 at cap 1 to -0.0012 at cap 50, reversing the underpowered v1 null at cutoff 10. Tail reserve still unpromoted; ALS still below its 0.0203 seed floor.
